preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 300000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must only contain the characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ':(' or (all(not is_correct(s[1:i]) for i in range(1, len(s))) and is_correct(s))
postconditions.description: If there is no valid solution, output ':('. Otherwise, all strict prefixes of the output string must not be correct parenthesis sequences, and the output string itself must be a correct parenthesis sequence.
